spec.title: MT-01 — minimal project installs and launches a GLM worker

status.comment: agent pre-run may report evidence; human sign-off remains open

p.PURPOSE: Prove on a fresh minimal project that the package materialises its boot contract, deploys receipt-owned launchers into an isolated `$VIBE_SETTINGS/opt/bin` (production default: `~/.vibe/opt/bin`), and can use one of those exact bytes for a bounded real GLM worker task. The test never copies or prints a credential and consumes at most one fresh run plus one same-cwd correction.

facts.CURRENT-VIBE: A `vibe.exe` built from the tree that contains `package:static-file` and `deploy:vibe-opt-launcher`.
facts.LIVE-TOKEN-SOURCE: For the live half only, the normal z.ai token source exists. The test checks existence and passes its path to the launcher; it never reads, hashes, copies or reports the value.

p.EXPECTED-PACKAGE: Expected: exit 0 and `PACKAGE_E2E_OK`. The preserved evidence root contains a minimal project, exact installed package slot, generated boot with each required marker once, isolated deployment records, and byte-identical `claudez.ps1`/`.cmd` under the fake settings root's `opt/bin`. The operator home and token source are unchanged.

step-live.title: Step 2 — one bounded live GLM task

p.EXPECTED-LIVE: Expected: the package smoke remains green, the launcher returns the real child exit, structured terminal JSON carries a nonempty child `session_id` and only GLM `modelUsage` keys, the worker's explicit model answer equals one of those keys, and output ends with `LIVE_GLM_E2E_OK passes=1` plus an evidence-root path. `proof.json` contains the run nonce and `GLM_E2E_OK`; the durable worker report contains the same nonce. A normal-success artifact defect may use exactly one same-cwd repair and then prints `passes=2`. A 429, quota wall, gateway failure or stall is reported as transport unavailable and is not retried.

p.HUMAN-SIGNOFF: Inspect the generated boot, deployed launcher paths, proof/report and bounded transport summary. Confirm that the workflow is understandable from either the Claude-parent or Codex-parent clause and that no token value appears. Only a human records final sign-off; an agent reports its pre-run without changing this test to done.

p.PASS: Package check is clean; the non-live smoke passes; the live task completes within the two-pass ceiling; all evidence is preserved; user-home and secret boundaries hold; and human inspection signs off the installed workflow.
